theorems.name: Submission.lcmp_imRep_measure_restrict
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), R.measure ≪ μHE[n].restrict R.carrier ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable R.orient R.measure ∧ ∀ (E : Set (Euclid P)) (R' : IMRep U n), MeasurableSet E → R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E → R'.mult = R.mult → R'.orient = R.orient → R'.measure = R.measure.restrict E ∧ ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, R'.action ω = ∫ x in E, R.orient x (ω x) ∂R.measure
